channel.title: Alex Zerntev
channel.description: Notes on building with coding agents, production agent systems, software architecture, and engineering judgment.

item.title: Old Software, New Hands
item.description: Existing software carries years of experience with real problems. AI agents can build on that foundation by operating the tools we already use.

item.title: Reality Doesn’t Fit in a Prompt
item.description: Models can process a description of what is, but they do not share the lived context from which we decide what should be.

item.title: Rebuilding this site with coding agents
item.description: What stayed human while I rebuilt my website with coding agents - taste, vetoes, and a decision log that kept rejected directions from coming back.
